name: llm_hourly_spend_high
title: LLM spend above 50 USD in an hour
description: Model calls cost more than 50 USD in the last 60 minutes, summed from gen_ai_usage_cost. Set the amount to your own budget after install. Unpriced models add no cost. Needs LLM spans in the traces stream named default; OpenObserve writes the gen_ai columns at ingest.

query_condition.sql: SELECT SUM(gen_ai_usage_cost) AS cost_usd, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM "default" WHERE gen_ai_response_model IS NOT NULL AND (gen_ai_operation_name IS NULL OR gen_ai_operation_name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings')) HAVING SUM(gen_ai_usage_cost) > 50

row_template: LLM spend {cost_usd} USD over {calls} calls in the last hour
